disclosures.title: This is a simulation
disclosures.text: All products, prices and market data in Aegis are sample or hypothetical data for demonstration only. No real money, brokerage connection or live market data is involved. Orders placed here are simulated in a sandbox account.

disclosures.title: Value can go down as well as up
disclosures.text: The value of any investment can fall as well as rise. Historical and stress-test figures describe the past or a hypothetical scenario; they are not a promise or prediction of future returns.

disclosures.title: This proposal passed a suitability check
disclosures.text: The compliance gate checked this proposal against your risk tier and the rules in force. A PASS or an acknowledged WARNING means no hard rule was broken — it does not remove the risk of loss.

disclosures.title: How the AI advisor works, and its limits
disclosures.text: The advisor uses a language model to answer questions and explain proposals. It can misunderstand you or explain something imperfectly. It does not pick your portfolio: fixed, tested rules for your risk tier do, and a compliance gate checks every proposal. It cannot place orders; only your own Confirm click can. Rules built on past data can still be wrong, and the compliance team can pause the advisor at any time.
